## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tang-pilgrim importation catalog**, the second of **Enchin's** 圓珍 five importation catalogs (cf. [KR6s0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0116), [KR6s0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0118)–[KR6s0120](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0120)). This catalog documents materials acquired in three southeast-coastal Tang prefectures — **Fúzhōu** 福州 (modern Fújiàn), **Wēnzhōu** 溫州 and **Tāizhōu** 台州 (both in Zhèjiāng) — during Enchin's Tang study mission. Includes both Buddhist canonical materials (sutras, vinaya, treatises, commentaries, records) and **outer books** (*wàishū* 外書 = secular literature). Preserved at T55 no. 2170. *notBefore* = **858**, *notAfter* = **858**. Catalog dynasty 日本.

See [KR6s0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0116) for substantive treatment.
